comment: She was great and worth the money.

One of the nicest profs youll ever have, the lady reminded me of a kindergarten teacher and she isnt too bad to look at either. Her quizes and tests are word for word from her class notes. If you cant get an A in this class youre a moron

Class was not very interesting, I would definitely recommend taking something else.  Voeks was very nice and usually pretty helpful but it was difficult to be interested since she didn't really bring anything special to the classroom.

probbaly the nicest lady i have ever met.  unfortunately she is too smart for her own good and her explanations can sometimes confuse you more.  if you put effort in, you will be rewarded, but if you choose to not study a lot for even small quizzes it will haunt you.

The nicest professor that I have had. Understands her subject and conveys it well.  I under-estimated the difficult at the beginning b/c she makes tests/quizzes seem easy. Quiz questions come from her workbook, test questions from quizzes.  If you work moderately hard, it should be an easy A.
EYE candy.... its too bad she likes to give hard quizzes

A very nice person. The class, tests, quizzes are easy, everything is highly organized. ALso, she is very hot, which could be distracting for some, though it keeps you awake at 8.15. Awesome, take her class, if you can.
Great professor. Always willing to help during office hours. Class structure is impressive and easy to follow.
Lisa is a really cool person. Try to get her class if u can.

Dr. Voeks was incredibly.  Her class seemed easy because of her organized teaching style.  She is clear about exactly what material you need to know, so studying for quizes/tests/exams was not frustrating or a waste of time.
She's extremely nice and always willing to answer any questions.
